name: Wounded Bull / blanked-no-trigger
notes: CR6.6.1c-d: life condition is evaluated on triggered-layer resolution; a later life change does not revoke or retroactively add the granted effect. Source blanked before play has no trigger. No trigger pays additional AP/resources. Start during Guardian Bravo turn under previously resolved Blinding of the Old Ones; coverage is the known suppression interaction, not generation or expiry of Blinding. Sources: https://rules.fabtcg.com/pdf/en-fab-cr.pdf https://judge.fabtcg.com/cards/detail/3761/
